root_cause: the `manifest` stage of c2_publish.py calls the low-level publisher directly instead of going through the batch gate, exactly the hole the commander named in ORD-0288 (`Q57` proposal). The gate is the only thing that refuses a same-name/different-bytes write, and a direct call cannot see it.
